title: Design an e-commerce checkout flow.
description: Use a saga pattern for distributed transactions and idempotency keys for retries.

data.text: Split checkout into inventory reservation, payment capture, and order confirmation. Use the saga pattern for distributed transactions and idempotency keys to prevent double charges.

items: Cart service: validates items and calculates totals
Inventory service: reserves stock with TTL
Compensating transactions if any step fails
Forgetting to release inventory on failure
How do you handle partial refunds?
What if payment succeeds but order creation fails?
How do you prevent checkout fraud?

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Timeouts and retries need explicit policies
